title: Add gate-run artifact links to Console-facing Optimize APIs
author: Chloe Martin
description: Context: Optimize quality gates now produce structured results + artifacts (eval report HTML/JSON, metric breakdowns, prompt-set diff links, rerun provenance). Console needs stable, permissioned references to those artifacts to render the gate results view and the “blocked apply” reason details. This PR extends the Console-facing Optimize API responses to include (a) a compact gate result summary for each recommendation/config-diff and (b) artifact references (URLs or ids) that the UI can link to. What changed: Added `gate_summary` and `artifact_refs` fields to the Optimize recommendation payload and to the gate-run detail endpoint; `gate_summary` includes gate_run_id, state, tier (smoke/full), baseline_id, started_at/completed_at, top-level pass/fail reason codes, and a small set of headline deltas (e.g., task_success_delta, rubric_delta) for UI tables; `artifact_refs` includes report_html_url (short-lived), report_json_url (short-lived), raw_results_blob_id (stable), and prompt_set_run_ids for drilldowns; Implemented signing / access control: by default we return stable ids; for users with route-level read permission we also return presigned URLs (10 min TTL) via the Console API path; Updated OpenAPI schema + SDK types used by Console (internal) to reflect the new fields; Added redaction: internal-only fields (raw s3 keys, evaluator debug traces) are never returned; Included backwards compatibility: existing clients ignore unknown fields; for older Console versions, the response shape is unchanged. Notes: The goal here is UI consumption; this does not change gating decisions or enforcement. Follow-up work: wire UI to prefer `*_blob_id` and fetch signed URLs via `/artifacts/{id}:resolve` once that endpoint lands (tracked in ENG-3925 subtask).
commits: api: extend OptimizeRecommendation DTO with gate_summary + artifact_refs
console-api: add presigned artifact URL resolver with RBAC checks
tests: add contract tests for artifact refs and URL TTL behavior
docs: internal notes for Console wiring + example payloads
review_conversation: Dylan Brooks: Can we avoid returning raw URLs by default? Console will run in a browser; links should be stable + resolvable server-side to reduce leakage risk.

Chloe Martin (author): Agree. Updated so default payload returns blob ids; presigned URLs are only attached on Console API responses (server-side), gated by RBAC + short TTL. Added a comment in schema: clients should treat URLs as ephemeral.
Marcus Lin: Please ensure artifact URLs are not returned for users who can view recommendations but not the underlying route/account. Also log artifact resolution for auditability.

Chloe Martin (author): Added a `requireRouteRead()` check using the same policy as metrics dashboards; artifact resolution emits `audit.artifact_resolved` with gate_run_id + artifact_id + actor_id (no URL).
Jordan Lee: The `gate_summary.reason_codes` needs to be stable for policy/UI. Can we enumerate these in schema instead of freeform strings?

Chloe Martin (author): Added an enum list in OpenAPI for the initial set: QUALITY_REGRESSION, INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE, FLAKY_EVAL_QUARANTINED, EVAL_TIMEOUT, BASELINE_MISSING, VALIDATION_FAILED. Also added an `UNKNOWN` fallback.
Felix Schneider: UI needs an ordering of artifacts (report first, then raw results). Can we keep keys consistent and document them?
Chloe Martin (author): Done; `artifact_refs` now always includes keys (values may be null) and the OpenAPI descriptions specify intended UI ordering.
release_notes: Console-facing Optimize APIs now include gate-run summaries and permissioned artifact references (ids + short-lived URLs) to support the quality gate results UI.
